thread:
maria: Heads up — saw a billing blip in prod around 11:12 UTC. Session affinity routed to fallback region, then heartbeat gap, client resumed and we charged toolcall + streaming twice. Anyone else see?
jon: saw it, quick glance shows resume path sent a new session id before clearing provisional tokens :/ logs below
jon: ```log
[11:12:34] resume: session=abc123 provisional_tokens=12 route=eu-west -> fallback=us-south
[11:12:35] toolcall: id=tool-456 tokens_charged=12
[11:12:38] resume: session=abc123 new_session=def789 provisional_tokens=12
[11:12:39] toolcall: id=tool-999 tokens_charged=12
```
kevin: hmm looks like routing affinity didn't honor the "seatbelt" guard we added for midstream swaps (the in-flight swap lock)
maria: seatbelt should block a new session id until provisional tokens are either confirmed or expired. did the lock release early?
jon: tracing shows lock was held but hud-router accepted a rebind because prefetched snapshot TTL expired (1s) — step-through shows case where heartbeat loss > 500ms leads to snapshot invalidation and then a blind resume path issues a new session id
dev-bot: Observability alert: provisional-token-delta spike on 49988876 in prod
kevin: possible fixes: 1) extend snapshot TTL during fallbacks; 2) change ledger to mark provisional consumed on first toolcall and dedupe subsequent charges; 3) make resume path check provisional_id equality before issuing charge
maria: prefer #3 as smallest blast radius, but might need a short ledger migration to make provisional_id authoritative. #2 is heavier but more robust
jon: quick data ask — can someone query the token-ledger for session ids abc123 and def789 for last 7 days? need counts of double-charged events, timestamps, and route transitions
kevin: I can run the query and produce counts + a heatmap of routes. give me until noon PST. I'll also add a temporary dashboard panel in Console to surface provisional->confirmed transitions
maria: thanks. if counts > 100 we'll do a hotfix rollback plan. else schedule fix for next sprint
jon: also let's add a telemetry tag `resume_cause` (heartbeat_loss|client_reconnect|region_fallback) so we can slice incidents by root cause
maria: agreed. pinging @eng-sre for an early canary window
ops-echo: @maria noted. can we run the patch in canary region first? :thumbsup:
kevin: plan: 1) run ledger query, 2) add Console panel, 3) implement guard (check provisional_id on resume), 4) canary deploy + 24h monitor, 5) prod roll if clean
maria: assigning owners: @kevin to query + patch, @jon to telemetry + tracing annotation, @ops-echo to schedule canary. thanks folks.
